summary: Continuation testing for AUDIT Phase 2b-2c. Existing regression suites (18-test mongomock + 29-test live) still pass 100%. Added new live-integration suite /app/backend/tests/test_audit_phase2c_live.py (19 tests) covering RBAC sync (finance.efaktur/asset), CTL-09 master masking + bank-accounts guard + regex-safe q + number-series delete, FIN-05 petty cash (gl_account required, amount>0, SoD blocks self-approve, other user posts JE), FIN-09 payment validation shape, SEC-02 loyalty perms (procurement=403, outlet manager ok, verify guard), CTL-08 period list, and uploads (POST /api/uploads + GET, POST /api/admin/cms/upload-image). All 19 pass. Frontend smoke: finance@fnbgroup.id login → /outlet/petty-cash renders with data-testid='petty-cash-page', balance widget, 5 outlets, empty-state message. New transaction dialog button is disabled in aggregate mode by design (needs outlet selection); testids pc-direction-in, pc-direction-out, and pc-approve-<id> confirmed present in source. Payments Hub and Procurement PR pages route without console pageerrors (a few 403s on background fetches for scopes not held by finance user — not blocking).

integration_issues.issue: 'Transaksi Baru' button disabled when 'Semua Outlet' is selected. Empty-state text 'Pilih outlet spesifik...' is correct guidance, but consider making the button auto-focus outlet selector on click for discoverability.

verification_details.mongomock_regression: 18/18 PASS — cd /app/tests/audit_regression && ERP_BACKEND=/app/backend python -m pytest -q test_audit_fixes.py
verification_details.frontend_smoke: finance login → /outlet/petty-cash renders; direction/approve testids confirmed in source (line 200, 366-370 of PettyCashList.jsx). Payments Hub + Procurement PR load without JS errors.

critical_code_review_comments: FINANCE_MANAGER role currently lacks outlet.daily_sales.read, so finance users cannot CREATE petty cash even though they can APPROVE. Not a bug per se (create is an outlet-manager action) but the review request implied finance user would test the FIN-05 flow end-to-end; consider adding outlet.daily_sales.read to FINANCE_MANAGER GRANTS if finance UX is meant to include petty cash entry.
PettyCashList.jsx: 'Transaksi Baru' button is silently disabled in aggregate mode without a tooltip. Add a title or aria-disabled reason for a11y.

test_audit_phase2c_live.py::test_purchase_without_gl_account_400 verifies FIN-05 gl_account requirement; the 400 error uses `field='gl_account_id'` (good), but the router-level require_perm still passes through without checking outlet_scope of `outlet_id` in payload for admin — acceptable since admin has '*' but worth adding an outlet scope check for defense in depth.
test_credentials: All seed users Demo@2026 per /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Tokens are cached in-suite (30/min login rate limit).
seed_data_creation: Test suites create TEST_-prefixed petty cash replenish rows (Rp 1 each) via /api/outlet/petty-cash and 2 small PNG uploads (/api/uploads, /api/admin/cms/upload-image). Not cleaned up — negligible footprint but callable via TEST_ prefix if needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Three regression suites now exist and all pass 100%: (1) mongomock /app/tests/audit_regression/test_audit_fixes.py (18 tests, P0/P1 unit-level), (2) live /app/backend/tests/test_audit_phase2_live.py (29 tests, RBAC/reports/legacy PR retirement), (3) NEW live /app/backend/tests/test_audit_phase2c_live.py (19 tests, RBAC sync + CTL-09 master + FIN-05 petty cash SoD + SEC-02 loyalty perms + uploads). Deep FIN-03 voucher, FIN-06 urgent purchase petty method, FIN-09 payment gr/wh cross-checks, CTL-07 budget delete/unlock, CTL-08 period close block with submitted daily sales, A8 inventory transfer double-send, and loyalty redeem-insufficient-points paths were NOT exercised via live suite because they require heavier seed setup (approved GR + open period + inventory items + loyalty customer with points). All are already covered by mongomock test_audit_fixes.py — recommend those remain the source of truth. FINANCE_MANAGER does not have outlet.daily_sales.read so cannot create petty cash from Finance portal UI; only outlet manager can — main agent should confirm this is intentional.
